packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions workflow updates.
One grouped PR for npm/bun bumps, dev and prod together. Major bumps split into a separate npm-dependencies major PR via separateMajorMinor.
One PR for the Docker base image and the .nvmrc Node pin.
One PR for the MkDocs toolchain in docs/requirements.txt.
Auto-merge non-major bumps once CI is green. Major bumps open a PR for review.
Docs toolchain is reviewed by hand: mkdocs-material renames features between minors.
Hold non-major PRs 7 days so yanked or broken releases surface before automerge.
Hold major PRs 14 days for manual-review stability.
